text: A single strain, L. paracasei Shirota, slowly sours a heat-treated sweetened skim-milk base into a concentrate. This is homogenised, mixed with syrup and diluted into a thin, sweet drink.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.what: skim milk powder, sugar and dextrose in water

steps.note: The milk undergoes heat treatment to kill harmful bacteria like Listeria, Salmonella and E. coli.
The milk is soured for a long time by a bacterium that grows best at 30–38 °C, so it makes acid but little aroma.
